Subject: HIPAA: BAA availability & PHI handling (post-call)

Hi Lisa — thanks again for taking time today. Recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps below.

Summary of what we heard:
- You classify your workflows as having "limited PHI": patient names and appointment scheduling notes, no full clinical records sent to vendors.
- Primary concern: whether Redwood can sign a BAA and what deployment modes are eligible for PHI.
- Secondary: SOC 2 status and initial vendor questionnaire for your security team.

Our answers / immediate items:
- Redwood does offer a BAA for customers handling PHI. We support HIPAA-eligible deployments via Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) \u2014 hosted API is not covered for PHI use cases.
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II attested (scope: infrastructure, change management, access controls). I can share the attestation summary once you confirm landing page access.
- To accelerate procurement, please fill/return your vendor security questionnaire (I'll route to Dev for technical responses).

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm the specific PHI fields you expect to send (e.g., name, DOB, phone, limited notes) so we can validate scope? (Action: Lisa)
2) I'll loop in our security/engineering and send a draft BAA for your legal to review. (Action: Marissa)
3) If helpful, schedule a short technical call with our Sales Engineer to discuss data flows and deployment options (Dedicated vs Private). (Action: Marissa/Dev)
4) Please attach your vendor security questionnaire if available \u2014 we can complete the XLS and return within 2 business days. (Action: Lisa)

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks \u2014 happy to jump on another call.

Hi Marissa \u2014 thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side:

- PHI scope: patient name, DOB, phone, appointment notes, and short encounter summaries (no imaging, no raw EHR exports). We see Redwood being used to generate templated outreach and scheduling reminders that will include limited PHI.
- SOC 2 is important; yes we will need the attestation.
- Deployment preference: we would prefer Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput, but if Dedicated is not available in our region we'll evaluate Private (VPC). Hosted is not acceptable for PHI.

I attached our vendor security questionnaire (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) \u2014 please have your security/tech team complete the technical sections and return. Also: can you share a draft BAA for our legal team to review?
